name: davibank.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But the TLS certificate expires in 8 days.
lesson: Renew the TLS certificate automatically, and alert well before it expires.
summary: www.davibank.com scores 58 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: 400 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 400 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /segmentos, /pyme, /empresas and 96 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 435 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: The TLS certificate expires in 8 days
fix.evidence: Valid until 2026-10-30, issued by GlobalSign nv-sa.
fix.fix: Renew now and check that automatic renewal works.

fix.title: 4 JSON-LD blocks do not parse
fix.evidence: On /, /personas/tarjeta-de-credito, /personas/cuentas-e-inversion, /personas. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI crawlers.
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /personas, /pyme, for example .active[type="button"] and button[type="button"]:nth-child(2). Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 119 elements on /personas, /segmentos, /pyme, for example #tab1 > .sb-tab-content-all > .container-tab1 > .tab1-container.container-cards > .card_longImage.card > .card_container and #tab1 > .sb-tab-content-all > .container-tab1 >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 1.8 s
